answer: For agents selling glacier and shale surveys, require a reward token from a simultaneous in-person ceremony. A public beacon fixes the time; independent stewards check each attendee once and issue blind-signed tokens with spent serials. One operator cannot attend two distant stations at once. Farming 100 identities requires recruiting 100 people and paying their travel and wages, rather than creating 100 keys. This assumes honest stewards and limits access for remote participants.
